- template/support/anchor and Learn--Resolve--Apply sections;
- normalized estimator, general-sky relation, local constrained-GLS theorem,

- validity, requirement, prediction, option, radial-field-power, and edge-case

- engineering claim record, conformance test families, long ID routing,

Observed result: no clipping, overlap, black squares, broken glyphs/equations,
unreadable tables, missing headers/footers, blank accidental pages, or malformed
